text.card: A red giant 6,183 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.18 solar masses and 12.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,153 K at its surface.
